items.title: 3 Volatile Stocks We Steer Clear Of
items.summary: A highly volatile stock can deliver big gains - or just as easily wipe out a portfolio if things go south. While some investors embrace risk, mistakes can be costly for those who aren’t prepared.

items.title: RITM's Credit Rating Upgraded to 'B+' by S&P, Outlook Remains Stable
items.summary: Rithm Capital's credit rating is upgraded to 'B+' from 'B' by S&P Global, with a stable outlook, reflecting greater diversification and stable Newrez earnings.

items.title: Fed Considers Higher Asset Thresholds: What it Means for Banks
items.summary: Fed considers higher bank asset thresholds that could ease regulatory burdens, and give banks more room to grow and pursue M&A.

items.title: Capital One Financial (COF) Joins Banks Warning On AI Shopping Agent Risks
items.summary: Capital One Financial (NYSE: COF) joined a coalition of global banks warning about risks from AI shopping agents acting for customers. The group highlighted concerns that AI-powered purchasing tools could increase exposure to scams, fraud and data privacy breaches. Banks in the coalition are calling for clearer disclosure standards and customer safeguards when AI agents initiate or authorize financial transactions. items.title: ‘It Won’t Work’: Clark Howard Warns Capital One Quietly Moved Its Cheapest Customers to Discover
items.summary: Capital One quietly shifted certain cardholders onto a network that gets declined at hotel desks and taxi stands across Europe and Asia, and the reason comes down to a financial calculation most customers never see coming.

items.title: ‘A Better Rate Than a Student Loan’: Clark Howard Tells Texas Dad Where His College Money Is Hiding
items.summary: A Texas dad sitting on a 15-year-old whole life policy just found out his family owns a lender that federal loan rates cannot touch, but the fine print rewrites the math depending on which school his son picks.
